'''Kirter''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he trained [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]].
